response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, which is a strong seniority mismatch for an entry-level Junior Java Developer role. Java appears only marginally in his skill set (last in the list, used briefly for robotics/mobile tooling years ago), his primary stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, and his German is listed as only 'Basic' against a role requiring strong verbal and written German for client-facing insurance consulting work.
strengths: Extensive professional software development experience with strong OOP and agile/CI/CD practices
Demonstrated ability to design complex architectures and work across full stacks and industries
Strong communication and mentoring skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Vastly overqualified/senior for an entry-level junior position, raising retention and salary-fit concerns
Java is not a core or recent skill; primary expertise is in JS/TypeScript and DLang
German proficiency listed as 'Basic', falling short of the required strong verbal/written German for insurance client work
